title: SynthForge — Enterprise Synthetic Data Platform
summary: A full-stack synthetic data generation platform (FastAPI backend + React frontend) that trains CTGAN or TVAE models on uploaded tabular data to produce statistically similar synthetic datasets for sharing, augmentation, testing, and compliance use cases. It runs SDV's CTGANSynthesizer and TVAESynthesizer via SingleTableMetadata to fit and sample synthetic tabular data.
needs: Multi-table HMASynthesizer and Condition-based sampling are described in FEATURE_REQUIREMENTS.md as planned/spec, not confirmed implemented in code.
